description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We are running a paid study on the quality and accuracy of artificial intelligence models tailored for the management consulting industry. By having domain experts review the generated text, we can better understand where the models succeed and where they lack strategic depth. Your feedback directly improves the reliability of these business analysis tools.

HOW IT WORKS

You will participate in a remote session to review various AI-generated outputs related to business strategy and consulting scenarios. During the task, you will read through specific prompts and the corresponding model responses. You will then annotate the text for factual accuracy, structural logic, and professional tone. Finally, you will provide written feedback on how to improve the overall quality of the insights.

WHO THIS IS FOR

We are looking for experienced management consultants and strategy professionals who are deeply familiar with industry-standard deliverables. We welcome strategy consultants, business analysts, operations consultants, and advisory professionals. Ideal candidates have strong analytical skills and a sharp eye for professional business communication.

title: Staff Machine Learning Software Engineer
description:
About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

About the role

We are looking for an ML Software Engineer to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member.

MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments-including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world.

You will design and build the software systems that enable MEGA's machine learning research. This includes scalable ML pipelines, data and training infrastructure, and the shared tools and abstractions that allow researchers to move quickly from an idea to a reliable experiment.

The role sits close to the models and data. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets, modern ML frameworks, and increasingly large models, building systems that remain reliable and maintainable as the research program grows. A major part of the role will be designing and maintaining robust workflows and reusable infrastructure that can support multiple ML projects. This emphasis on infrastructure, software systems, repo health, testing and maintainability is central to the role.

You will be a core member of the MEGA team, owning key parts of the software and ML infrastructure that underpin the research program. You will work directly on the systems used to build, train, evaluate, and scale our models, and help shape how the team develops and operates its ML stack as the program grows.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, evaluation, and related research workflows.

• Build software systems that allow ML workloads to scale to larger datasets, larger models, and more experiments.

• Develop clean and reusable interfaces between data, models, training, evaluation, and downstream robotics workflows.

• Own and improve the health of the MEGA codebase, including software architecture, testing, reliability, maintainability, and engineering standards.

• Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and usability bottlenecks across ML workflows.

• Build and maintain infrastructure that supports multiple researchers and ML projects without unnecessarily slowing down iteration.

• Work closely with researchers to understand the requirements of new models and experiments, and translate those requirements into practical software solutions.

• Build and use distributed training and data-processing pipelines for large models and large multimodal datasets.

About You

In order to set you up for success as an ML Software Engineer at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

• Strong software engineering skills and experience building high-quality, maintainable software.

• Experience

title: Senior Cryptography Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel:  
Job ID: 1893 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities :

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

• Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS

• Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

• Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills

• Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

This person works independently, knows when to escalate, and maintains accuracy and composure during high-volume periods.

• Administer all health and welfare plans day to day, including medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life and AD&D, short- and long-term disability, EAP, and voluntary benefits.

• Process enrollments, qualifying life events, terminations, and COBRA notifications; audit for accuracy and timeliness.

• Coordinate benefits continuation and premium payment for employees on leave of absence: maintain carrier eligibility during leave, calculate and collect employee premium contributions, track arrears, and partner with Payroll on catch-up deductions upon return. Work from leave status, type, and dates provided by HR Business Partners, who own leave administration.

• Execute open enrollment under the direction of the Manager: configure and test the system, prepare and distribute communications, deliver employee education sessions, respond to questions, and complete the post-enrollment audit.

• Support the annual renewal cycle by compiling census, claims, and utilization data for the broker and Manager, and by preparing analysis to inform plan design and contribution recommendations.

• Administer the 401(k) plan operationally: contribution and loan feeds, eligibility and enrollment monitoring, and preparation of data for nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500, and the annual plan audit.

• Serve as first-line support for employee benefits questions, claims issues, and eligibility inquiries; escalate complex disputes and exception requests.

• Maintain vendor relationships at the service level - open and track tickets, hold carriers to service standards, and flag performance concerns to the Manager.

HRIS Administration & Reporting

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (Physical AI & Autonomy)
description:

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

This is a senior, high-trust role owning the product narrative for Alfie, RobCo's flagship Physical AI product line - the fastest-moving, highest-margin part of our business and the centerpiece of our category leadership story. You'll also carry a rare kind of stakes: Alfie debuts publicly at RobCoN in March 2027 - the biggest product launch in RobCo's history. Getting there is a multi-month campaign spanning film, digital, and physical activation, and you will own video production for Alfie end-to-end across it. We care more about how well you understand the technology - and the people selling it - than about your marketing pedigree. If you've spent years elbow-deep in robotics, automation, or industrial engineering, and you have a real talent for explaining complex things clearly - to a sales rep, a customer, or a skeptical engineer - we want to hear from you. A background in Product Marketing is a plus, not a prerequisite.

1. Own the Alfie & Physical AI Narrative

- Develop the core messaging and positioning for Alfie - value props, differentiators, use cases - and own the framework that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and External Comms all draw from.

- Translate complex robotics and AI concepts into language that lands with the audience in front of you, whether that's a plant manager, a procurement lead, or a skeptical engineer.

2. Content & Sales Enablement

- Own the Alfie whitepaper, technical datasheets, solution briefs, and use case fact sheets - written to be used, not filed away.

- Run enablement sessions so commercial teams can articulate Alfie's value confidently and consistently.

3. A Real Seat at the Product Table

- Named Product/Engineering counterpart and a recurring, calendar-mandated syncs.

- Own video production for Alfie end-to-end - from the recurring proof-point films that build the campaign through to the flagship film that plays live on the RobCoN stage.

- Drive Alfie's presence across the full run-up to RobCoN - our biggest product launch to date - partnering closely with Product and external creative partners to ship against a fixed, public-facing calendar.

- Own the RobCoN messaging framework and speaker briefing materials, and help shape how the live stage moments land.

- This is a high-visibility, high-stakes mandate: the work you ship here will be seen by the entire company, our customers, and the market, at the most important moment in RobCo's history so far.

We're hiring for depth of technical understanding first.

- A track record of turning technical complexity into content

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones .

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Malaga, Spain
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

We are hiring our founding Robot Operators in the United States, starting with our first pilot in San Antonio, Texas.

You will help bring a system already used on sites in the Netherlands and the UK to a new market. As one of our first US operators, you will help establish how we work on site and give our engineering team direct feedback from the field.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is hands-on construction work with robots. You will move bricks and mortar, keep the robots supplied, set up equipment and clean the site. You will also operate the robots using Atrium, our in-house software, and work with our engineers when something needs fixing.

No previous robotics or construction experience is required. We are looking for practical people with technical intuition, an eye for detail and the initiative to solve problems. We will train you to operate our systems. This is a full-time role. Training starts at our headquarters in Amsterdam, with costs covered by Monumental.

Our operators come from construction, retail, hospitality, events, farms, workshops and engineering. What they share is a preference for working with their hands and seeing the things they build.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare construction projects: understand the build plan and assess site conditions.

- Place markers and take photos for 3D reconstruction.

- Set up and operate masonry robots using a laptop and our software.

- Carry and load bricks and mortar, move equipment and keep the work area safe and tidy.

- Help with site tasks such as cutting bricks, setting wall ties and pointing walls.

- Troubleshoot with our engineering and operations teams.

- Record problems and improvements so our engineers can develop the hardware and software.

- Work with the contractors and trades around you as the face of Monumental on site.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- A practical, technical mindset and a willingness to learn.

- Comfort with physical work outdoors, early starts and changing site conditions.

- Attention to detail: the quality of the finished wall matters.

- Initiative when something does not go to plan.

- A valid driver’s license and comfort driving to construction sites.

- Good spoken and written English for working with our team.

- Construction, maintenance or other hands-on experience is useful, but not required.

LOCATION

This is an on-site role in San Antonio, Texas, starting with our first US pilot. You need to be able to work on construction sites in the San Antonio area. This is not a remote role.

WHY MONUMENTAL?

You will be part of the team bringing our robots to US construction sites for the first time. The work combines physical building, technical problem-solving and direct collaboration with the people developing the robots. Your feedback will help shape the next deployment.

Learn more about Monumental https://www.monumental.co/about, Atrium https://www.monumental.co/atrium and life as a Robot Operator https://www.monumental.co/blog/the-best-product-job-isnt-in-engineering.

If you do not meet every line above but enjoy building things and solving practical problems, we would still like to hear from you.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

Welcome to Energy Vault ® (NYSE:NRGV) , a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets.

Energy Vault ’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world.

Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security.
By combining asset ownership with advanced technologies and integration expertise, Energy Vault is building the next generation of critical energy infrastructure, delivering dependable power when and where it matters most.

Our Values

We Commit: To Building a Better Future for Earth and All Its Beings.

We Innovate: Cutting Edge Solutions to Accelerate the Unique Energy Aspirations of Our Clients.

We Connect: To Build Genuine Relationships.

We Deliver: Going Above & Beyond by Being Fast & Nimble.

• Oversee day-ahead trading strategy, developing views of market fundamentals to guide the daily allocation of BESS capacity between the Day-Ahead Energy, Real-Time Energy, and Ancillary Service markets.

• Act as the team’s subject-matter expert on wholesale electricity trading,

About this Team

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) team at OpenAI partners with leaders to navigate complex organizational and talent decisions where the right path is not always obvious. We are building a higher-leverage HRBP model: staying close enough to the business to understand its realities, while focusing our time on the work that requires judgment, influence, context, and leadership partnership.

This role is for an HRBP who can diagnose ambiguous situations, translate business strategy into organizational and talent decisions, coach leaders through consequential choices, and help build the operating rhythms that enable scale. While the role spans both strategic and operational work, the bar is not to be helpful on everything. The bar is to improve decision quality, strengthen leadership capability, and increase organizational effectiveness.

We operate with urgency, empathy, and sound judgment. We value sincerity, intellectual honesty, and collaboration over ego, and focus relentlessly on creating meaningful impact.

About this Role

This role is part of a shared hiring pathway for HRBPs at OpenAI. Instead of hiring directly for a single team, we evaluate candidates holistically first, then identify the best fit across our organization as you advance. This approach ensures alignment between your skills, interests, and where our needs are greatest-whether that’s partnering with technical leaders in engineering, supporting product teams driving user impact, or enabling operational excellence across business functions.

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you’ll be a trusted advisor to leaders and their teams. You’ll help set direction for how we organize, grow, and lead-stepping in as both a sounding board and a problem-solver. This role mixes strategic advising with hands-on support: you’ll design better systems, coach managers through complex situations, and help us make trade-offs that keep our people and mission in balance. - Evolve People programs: Strengthen performance, engagement, and retention processes-building solutions that are lightweight, scalable, and aligned with how OpenAI operates.

- Guide and develop managers: Offer candid, actionable feedback and help managers build leadership muscle across their teams.

- Anticipate and act fast: Stay close to the business to identify challenges early, diagnose root causes, and deliver lasting solutions that adapt as priorities shift.

- Lead change that matters: Drive organizational changes with empathy, clarity, and rigor-finding creative paths forward when playbooks don’t exist.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Deep HRBP expertise: 7-10+ years of HR experience, including at least 5 years as an HR Business Partner in high-growth or complex environments.

- Strategic partnering: Able to see the big picture, guide leaders through tough trade-offs, and adapt quickly when priorities shift.

- Multipliers who create impact: Skilled at giving candid feedback with care and building leadership capabilities across organizations.

- Scrappy problem solving: Uses sound judgment to diagnose challenges, test creative solutions, and chart a path forward without a playbook.

- Change leadership with calm & clarity: Brings steadiness, empathy, and influence in moments of ambiguity or transition.

- High integrity: Known for discretion, fairness, and trustworthiness when the stakes are high.

description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be one of the founding data scientist on Replit's Growth team, working with Product and Engineering leadership across acquisition, activation and recommender systems, and helping shape how Replit experiments.

This role is for someone who doesn't wait to be asked. You spot problems and opportunities before anyone else does, bring a strong point of view, and push it until it changes what we build.

YOU WILL:

- Own data science for major growth areas, partnering with PMs and engineers from problem framing and sizing through launch and readout

- Make fast decisions trustworthy: we ship weekly and need a decision within days, but retention takes weeks to show up. You'll design the experiments and metrics that close that gap; for example, variance reduction (CUPED), sequential testing, and short-term proxy metrics validated against long-term retention and revenue

- Help set the experimentation standards teams rely on for Replit's highest-traffic surfaces: how metrics and guardrails are defined, and the checks that catch a broken test before it misleads anyone

- Use quasi-experimental designs (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, regression discontinuity) where randomization isn't feasible, such as pricing changes and regional launches

- Help define the data science behind an emerging personalization and recommendations workstream: problem framing, offline and online evaluation, and measuring incremental lift

- Model the economics of a freemium, usage-based product: credit consumption, conversion, and how pricing and limits change behavior

- Develop user and project segmentation from behavioral and content signals (e.g., embeddings and clustering) so growth analysis reflects what people are actually building

- Partner with Data Engineering on a shared metrics layer and experimentation tooling

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 6+ years in data science, with significant time on growth or experimentation for high-scale prosumer, PLG, or self-serve products

- Data science experience at a fast-growing startup, where you built metrics, datasets, and experimentation practices without much existing infrastructure

- Deep expertise in experimental design and statistical inference, including reaching reliable decisions when readout windows are short and the outcomes that matter are slow

- Experience establishing experimentation standards or platforms adopted by multiple teams

- Expert SQL and Python

- A track record of analysis that changed what a team shipped, and of influencing senior Product and Engineering leaders

- Heavy, practical use of AI tools to move faster in your own work

Constructor Fabric turns a company's informal knowledge into production software through a pipeline of composable capability units called gears : requirements → architecture → product fit → framework (G1) → application → runtime. We are building a World Model over that pipeline - a model that does not just generate code, but predicts the consequences of an architectural decision: total cost of ownership, unintended side effects, latency and failure behaviour, and whether a proposed composition is even admissible.

The central object is not a digital twin of the application but its formal architectural skeleton : gear contracts (GearSpec), a typed attributed hypergraph of the application (AppGraph), a composition algebra that defines which assemblies are legal, and several semantic projections (types, protocols, resources, security) over which properties are proved, refuted by counterexample, or reported as an explainable gap . All of it is written in a domain-specific language whose syntax trees and graphs we keep in a projectional editor (JetBrains MPS) - so the DSL is not a convenience layer, it is the thing that defines the model's state space and the boundary of what the model is allowed to propose.

title: Assistant Lane Support SME - Remote
description:
Primary Mission:

The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises. The position assists the Lane Support SME in coordinating logistics, manpower, resources, exercise infrastructure, and administrative requirements across assigned areas of operation.

The Assistant Lane Support SME must demonstrate strong organizational, logistical, asset deconfliction, and project management capabilities while supporting multiple exercises in various stages of development and execution. The position requires effective coordination with military personnel, Government agencies, civilian authorities, and domestic and international exercise participants in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Role and Responsibilities

• Provide operational, logistical, and administrative support to the WVNG Joint Staff Office, WVNG J37, WVNG J3 Joint Operations Center, and Ridge Runner Program in support of exercise planning, coordination, and execution.

• Assist the Lane Support SME with planning, development, coordination, and execution of Ridge Runner training activities, including Concept Development Conferences (CDC), Initial Planning Conferences (IPC), Mid Planning Conferences (MPC), Final Planning Conferences (FPC), and post-exercise closeout activities.

• Coordinate with domestic and foreign exercise participants, military organizations, Government agencies, and external stakeholders to synchronize exercise requirements, resources, schedules, and operational support.

• Support exercise lane development, site preparation, setup, execution, and recovery, including coordination with local business owners, municipal officials, and private landowners for access to facilities, infrastructure, and training locations through the Realistic Military Training (RMT) Packet process.

• Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, and emergency medical services to support exercise integration, public safety, and operational requirements.

• Prepare and coordinate exercise notifications and required Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Letters of Understanding (LOUs) with applicable jurisdictions, organizations, and property owners.

• Assist the Lane Support SME with exercise lane management, safety coordination, logistical support, personnel accountability, and resolution of operational or administrative issues during exercise execution.

• Support the coordination and delivery of Irregular Warfare training activities, instructional preparation, and exercise-related briefings in accordance with established Ridge Runner training objectives and program requirements.

• Perform administrative functions including event scheduling, calendar management, email and telephone correspondence, meeting coordination, note-taking, records maintenance, document organization, and tracking of assigned actions.

• Assist with coordination of foreign participant requirements, including foreign visit requests, installation access procedures, and communication with appropriate Government representatives when required.

• Maintain effective communication with Ridge Runner leadership, the Lane Support SME, exercise controllers, and participating organizations to identify emerging requirements, resolve coordination issues, and ensure continuity of exercise support.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• None

Required Qualifications and Education

•
Special Operations Experience: Minimum five (5) years of operational experience as an operator within a U.S. Special Operations organization, including USASOC, MARSOC, or NSWDG, with at least three (3) years of administrative or operational support to senior leaders in high-tempo or mission-driven environments.

title: Junior Category Manager
description:
About the role: What’s in the Box

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

Please note: For junior positions, we are unable to offer visa or work permit sponsorship, either now or in the future. To be considered, you must already have the legal right to work in your preferred location.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Our benefits vary by country. Here is a taste of what you can expect:

• Tasty discounts : generous discounts on HelloFresh and our other brands, plus savings with partner brands.

• Learning & growth : internal training, and mentoring opportunities

• Flexibility : a hybrid working setup

• A warm welcome : an onboarding program and a dedicated manager

• Wellbeing : discounted fitness memberships and access to mental health and mindfulness apps.

• Financial security : a company pension scheme and commuting support, depending on your location.

• Great people : team events, Friday drinks and a lively office culture.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

Translate data into clear, actionable plans. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

AI-native - integrating AI tools into your day-to-day work to drive faster execution, better insight, and smarter workflows.

Curious. Commercially aware. Direct. Adaptable. Strong at building trust. Open to feedback. You don’t avoid hard conversations. You don’t wait for issues to escalate. You don’t need constant direction.

6 months in: renewals are planned early, NRR targets are on track, expansion opportunities are clearly mapped, delivery runs smoothly, and leadership trusts your forecast.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Location: Remote, anywhere in the US, occasional travel to our UK and Budapest offices

About Kodesage
Join Kodesage 's revolution to transform how enterprises understand, operate, and modernize their legacy systems. We're a growing team building an integrated service and AI-augmented legacy modernization platform, working on cutting-edge tech.
At Kodesage , you'll have freedom and flexibility in a passionate, seasoned team. We're looking for people who thrive on ownership and believe the best ideas win. If you're ready to make a real impact in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!
Why this role exists
Kodesage 's AI platform and its tailor-made solution for Oracle Forms migrations and production support are coming to the US. As our first Senior Account Executive in the US, you open the market: you win our first US customers and shape how we sell here.
What you'll do

• Win our first US enterprise customers for Oracle Forms migration and production support

• Own the full sales cycle, from qualified lead to signed contract

• Build the US pipeline and sales playbook with marketing, partners and our founders

• Work with Presales and Forward Deployed Engineers to grow each account after the first deal

What you bring

• You've sold or delivered Oracle projects, especially Oracle Forms, APEX or EBS. That's our one non-negotiable, and SaaS experience can't replace it

• Ideally you come from Oracle, or from an Oracle practice at a top-tier or boutique consultancy

• You know large consulting or systems-integrator environments, and you can sell a platform-led solution, not just services

• You've closed six-figure, long-cycle enterprise deals, keeping 5-10 stakeholders across IT, procurement and the C-suite moving

• You own a deal end to end: discovery, pipeline, negotiation, and growing the account after the first signature

Nice to have

• Sold migration, modernization or professional services into enterprises

• Partner and channel experience with system integrators or technology alliances

• Sold AI-powered products or developer tools to risk-averse buyers; a network among US enterprises running Oracle Forms

How we work

• Ownership: you run your deals end to end without needing to be managed

• Customer focus: you sell what solves their problem, not what's easiest to close

• Speed with structure: you move fast, keep the CRM current and forecast honestly

• Know the domain: you understand Oracle Forms and why enterprises modernize, because credibility wins trust

• Collaboration: you bring Presales, FDEs, marketing and founders in at the right time

The industry left legacy systems behind, but we didn't. Join a team decoding complex systems that even the best AI models can't crack on their own.

Our compensation takes into account the cost of labor in the different US markets we hire in. Where you land in the range depends on several factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Base salary: $120,000 - $150,000
On-target earnings (OTE): $240,000 - $300,000
